declarations.docstring: The auxiliary permutation trace is a sum over partitions of natural-number counts multiplied by associated complex values.
A factorial multiple of an auxiliary partition count equals a sum of trace values weighted by the associated value at inverse permutations.
The isotypic components indexed by partitions form an independent indexed supremum.
The supremum of the partition-indexed isotypic components is the whole module.
Every simple submodule is linearly equivalent to the auxiliary subtype associated with some partition.
An auxiliary complex submodule associated with a partition of `n`.
The complex finrank of an auxiliary partition submodule is its auxiliary count times the finrank of the corresponding auxiliary subtype.
The family of auxiliary partition submodules forms an internal direct sum.
An auxiliary natural-number value attached to a module and a partition of `n`.
Finite modules with equal auxiliary permutation traces have equal auxiliary counts at every partition.
An auxiliary complex-valued function of permutations attached to a finite complex module.
The complex-linear endomorphism of a module associated with a permutation.
The permutation endomorphism acts by scalar multiplication with the corresponding monoid-algebra basis element.
For the module induced by a representation, the auxiliary permutation endomorphism is evaluation of that representation.
Every auxiliary permutation endomorphism preserves each auxiliary partition submodule.
The trace of a finite-dimensional representation at a permutation equals the auxiliary trace of its induced module.
The trace of a finite-dimensional permutation representation is a partition sum of auxiliary counts times associated values.
An auxiliary natural-number value attached to a permutation representation and a partition.
Finite-dimensional permutation representations with identical traces have equal auxiliary natural-number values at every partition.
A nonzero auxiliary representation count supplies an auxiliary map whose underlying function is injective.
A nonzero auxiliary module count supplies an auxiliary map whose underlying function is injective.
An auxiliary statement whose displayed formal type contains an elided term.
